def solve(case):
    capacity = case["capacity"]
    trials = case["trials"]
    memory = []
    for i, trial in enumerate(trials):
        entry = {
            "last_trial": i,
            "reflection": trial["reflection"],
            "signature": trial["signature"],
            "success": trial["success"]
        }
        memory.append(entry)
        # deduplicate failures
        seen = set()
        new_memory = []
        # iterate in reverse
        for e in reversed(memory):
            if e["success"]:
                new_memory.insert(0, e)
            else:
                sig = e["signature"]
                if sig not in seen:
                    seen.add(sig)
                    new_memory.insert(0, e)
        memory = new_memory
    # after all trials, memory is deduplicated for failures
    # trim to capacity
    if len(memory) > capacity:
        # priority sort: failures first, then recency (higher last_trial), then signature
        memory.sort(key=lambda e: (e["success"], -e["last_trial"], e["signature"]))
        # take first capacity
        memory = memory[:capacity]
        # restore chronological order
        memory.sort(key=lambda e: e["last_trial"])
    # extract signatures
    signatures = [e["signature"] for e in memory]
    return {"memory": memory, "signatures": signatures}
